name: Chikuhoku (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Chikuhoku village emblem in white: a disc bearing a green stylised bird-like device.
history: Municipal flag of Chikuhoku, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Chikuhoku village emblem — a disc bearing a green stylised bird-like device
